Mycology

Fungus, candidiasis, cryptococcus, aspergillus & clinical mycology
M1

What is fungus? Mention the characteristics of fungus. Fungus vs. Bacteria. ********

▾
📌 Hint: Eukaryotic, chitin cell wall, 80S ribosomes, exospore, etc.
▾ ✅ Answer

Fungus: Fungi are chlorophyll-free eukaryotic organisms that may be unicellular or multicellular and reproduce by sexual and asexual spores. The term comes from Greek mykos or mykes meaning fungus/mushroom. Medical mycology is the branch dealing with medically important fungi, and mycosis is any fungal infection.

Characteristics of Fungus:

  • Cell type: Eukaryote with a true nucleus and membrane-bound organelles (mitochondria, ER).
  • Cell number: May be unicellular (yeast) or multicellular (mold).
  • Cell wall: 90% polysaccharide, 10% protein. Contains chitin (polymer of N-acetyl glucosamine), chitosan (soluble derivative of chitin), and β-glucan (polymer of D-glucose).
  • Cytoplasmic membrane: Contains sterols — ergosterol and zymosterol.
  • Ribosomes: 80S (40S + 60S).
  • Chlorophyll: Absent — they require an organic carbon source.
  • Reproduction: By budding (asexual) or by sexual and asexual spores.
  • Oxygen requirement: Mostly strict aerobes; some facultative anaerobes. No obligate anaerobes.
  • Natural habitat: Mostly in the environment (soil, decaying organic matter).
#PointFungusBacteria
1Cell typeEukaryotesProkaryotes
2Cell numberUnicellular or multicellularUnicellular
3Cell wallChitin, chitosan, β-glucanPeptidoglycan
4Cell membraneSterol present (ergosterol, zymosterol)Sterol absent (except Mycoplasma)
5Cytoplasm-bound organellesPresentAbsent
6Ribosomes80S (40S + 60S)70S (30S + 50S)
7NucleusTrue (eukaryotic)Primitive / nucleoid (prokaryotic)
8SporeExospore (reproduction)Endospore (survival)
9ReproductionBudding or sexual & asexual sporesBinary fission
10TreatmentAntifungal drugAntibacterial drug
11Organic carbon requirementRequired (no obligate anaerobes)Not required by all
12Thermal dimorphismYes (some)No
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Antifungal drugs-কে mode of action ধরে কীভাবে classification করা যায়?

৩ ভাবে করা যায় — (১) cell wall‑এ act করে: echinocandin β‑glucan synthesis inhibit করে; (২) cell membrane‑এ act করে: amphotericin B ও nystatin ergosterol‑এর সাথে bind করে, আর azole ও terbinafine ergosterol‑এর synthesis inhibit করে; (৩) nucleic acid‑এ act করে: flucytosine DNA synthesis inhibit করে ও griseofulvin mitotic spindle‑কে disrupt করে।

Amphotericin B আর azole—দুটোই ergosterol‑এর সাথে সম্পর্কিত, তাহলে action-এ পার্থক্যটা কী?

পার্থক্য আছে। Amphotericin B সরাসরি ergosterol‑এর সাথে bind করে cell membrane‑এ pore তৈরি করে; কিন্তু azole ergosterol‑এর synthesis‑কে inhibit করে। অর্থাৎ একজন bind করে, আরেকজন তৈরিই হতে দেয় না।

Fungus-কে eradicate করা এত কঠিন কেন?

দুই কারণে — প্রথমত, animal host‑এর কাছে fungal cell wall‑এর polysaccharide degrade করার মতো enzyme নেই; দ্বিতীয়ত, selective toxicity অর্জন কঠিন, কারণ fungal cell আর human cell দুটোই eukaryote।

Fungi-র কিছু উপকারী দিক বলুন?

অনেক আছে — decomposition‑এর মাধ্যমে nutrient recycling করে; mushroom, cheese, bread, wine, beer তৈরি করে (food industry); drug ও antibiotic production‑এর biosynthetic factory; আর research‑এ model organism হিসেবে কাজ করে।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, মূল কথা হলো — fungus হলো chlorophyll‑মুক্ত, eukaryotic organism, যা unicellular বা multicellular হতে পারে এবং sexual ও asexual spore‑এর মাধ্যমে reproduce করে। Greek শব্দ mykos/mykes মানে fungus/mushroom। Medical mycology হলো সেই শাখা যা medically important fungi নিয়ে কাজ করে, আর mycosis হলো যেকোনো fungal infection।

Characteristics গুলো বলি — প্রথমত, cell type eukaryote, অর্থাৎ true nucleus, mitochondria, ER—মembranr ও membrane‑bound organelle আছে। দ্বিতীয়ত, cell number অনুযায়ী unicellular (yeast) বা multicellular (mold)। তৃতীয়ত, cell wall ৯০% polysaccharide ও ১০% protein — সেখানে থাকে chitin (N‑acetyl glucosamine‑এর polymer), chitosan (chitin‑এর soluble derivative) ও β‑glucan (D‑glucose‑এর polymer)।

Cytoplasmic membrane‑এ ergosterol ও zymosterol (sterol) থাকে — এটাই antifungal treatment‑এর target। Ribosome 80S (40S+60S)। Chlorophyll absent, তাই organic carbon source দরকার। Reproduction হয় budding দিয়ে বা sexual ও asexual spore দিয়ে। Oxygen requirement — বেশিরভাগ strict aerobe, কিছু facultative anaerobe; কিন্তু কোনো obligate anaerobe নেই। Natural habitat — soil, decaying organic matter, অর্থাৎ বেশিরভাগ environment‑এ।

এবার fungus vs bacteria তুলনা করি — fungus eukaryote, bacteria prokaryote; fungus unicellular বা multicellular, bacteria শুধু unicellular; fungus‑এর cell wall chitin, chitosan, β‑glucan, bacteria‑র peptidoglycan; fungus‑এর membrane‑এ sterol (ergosterol) আছে, bacteria‑তে নেই (Mycoplasma ছাড়া); ribosome fungus‑এ 80S, bacteria‑তে 70S; fungus‑এ true nucleus, bacteria‑তে primitive nucleoid; fungus‑এর spore exospore (reproduction), bacteria‑র endospore (survival); fungus budding বা spore দিয়ে, bacteria binary fission দিয়ে; treatment antifungal vs antibacterial; fungus‑এ organic carbon লাগবেই (obligate anaerobe নেই), bacteria‑র সবসময় লাগে না; আর কিছু fungus‑এ thermal dimorphism আছে, bacteria‑তে নেই।

M2

Mention the composition of cell wall and cell membrane of fungi. ****

▾
📌 Hint: Cell wall: chitin, D glucan; Cell membrane: ergosterol
▾ ✅ Answer

Cell Wall of Fungi:

  • Composed of 90% polysaccharide and 10% protein.
  • Chitin: A polysaccharide composed of long chains of N-acetyl glucosamine (NAG). Chitin is insoluble in most solvents and has no free amino groups.
  • Chitosan: A soluble derivative of chitin that has free amino groups.
  • β-D-Glucan: A polymer of D-glucose. Target of echinocandin antifungals.

Cell Membrane (Cytoplasmic Membrane) of Fungi:

  • Contains ergosterol and zymosterol (sterol components).
  • Ergosterol is the key target of many antifungal drugs (amphotericin B, nystatin bind directly; azoles and terbinafine inhibit its synthesis).
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Ergosterol clinically এত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কেন?

কারণ human cell membrane‑এ ergosterol থাকে না—থাকে cholesterol। এই পার্থক্যের উপরেই selective toxicity নির্ভর করে — amphotericin B ergosterol‑এর সাথে bind করে pore তৈরি করে, আর azole ergosterol synthesis inhibit করে। তাই fungus‑এর জন্য toxic, human cell‑এ কম ক্ষতি।

কোন antifungal cell wall‑এর উপর কাজ করে?

Echinocandin (caspofungin, micafungin) β‑glucan synthase inhibit করে। এটা বিশেষ, কারণ bacteria‑র cell wall‑এ তো peptidoglycan থাকে, β‑glucan নেই।

P. jiroveci‑র ক্ষেত্রে antifungal‑এ কী exception দেখা যায়?

P. jiroveci‑র cell membrane‑এ ergosterol নেই—থাকে cholesterol। তাই echinocandin ও conventional antifungal এই organism‑এর বিরুদ্ধে কম কার্যকর।

Fungal cytoplasm‑এ কী কী structure থাকে?

Cytoplasm‑এ 80S ribosome (40S+60S) থাকে, আর membrane‑bound organelle হিসেবে mitochondria ও endoplasmic reticulum থাকে।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, cell wall দিয়ে শুরু করি — এটা ৯০% polysaccharide ও ১০% protein দিয়ে তৈরি। Polysaccharide গুলো হলো chitin, chitosan ও β‑D‑glucan। Chitin হলো N‑acetyl glucosamine (NAG)‑এর long polymer, যা বেশিরভাগ solvent‑এ insoluble এবং free amino group থাকে না। Chitosan হলো chitin‑এর soluble derivative—এর free amino group থাকে। β‑D‑glucan হলো D‑glucose‑এর polymer, আর এটাই echinocandin antifungal‑এর target।

এবার cell membrane (cytoplasmic membrane) — এখানে থাকে ergosterol ও zymosterol (sterol component)। Ergosterol হলো অনেক antifungal drug‑এর key target — amphotericin B ও nystatin সরাসরি bind করে, আর azole ও terbinafine এর synthesis inhibit করে।

মনে রাখতে হবে — cell wall‑এ chitin ও β‑glucan, cell membrane‑এ ergosterol; এই দুটোই drug target। আর clinically গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হলো—human membrane‑এ cholesterol থাকে, ergosterol নয়, তাই amphotericin B ও azole selective toxicity দেখায়।

M3

Difference between fungal and bacterial spore. **** (bacterial endospore for survival, fungal exospore for reproduction)

▾
📌 Hint: bacterial endospore for survival, fungal exospore for reproduction
▾ ✅ Answer
PointFungal SporeBacterial Spore
TypeExosporeEndospore
PurposeReproduction (both sexual and asexual)Survival under harsh conditions (heat, desiccation, radiation)
FormationFormed externally from specialized structures (conidiophore, sporangium, or fragmentation of hyphae)Formed intracellularly within a vegetative bacterial cell
NumberMany spores produced at once from a single parentTypically one endospore per vegetative cell (one spore = one cell)
StructureSimple: single- or few-celled; no specialized cortexComplex: core, cortex, and thick protein coat (spore coat)
ResistanceResistant to some environmental stresses but far less than bacterial endosporesExtremely resistant to heat, chemicals, UV radiation, desiccation
GerminationGerminates to form new fungal hyphae or yeastGerminates back into a single vegetative cell
ExamplesZygospore, ascospore, basidiospore, conidia, sporangiospore, arthrospore, chlamydospore, blastosporeBacillus, Clostridium endospores
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Fungal sexual spore গুলো কী কী?

তিনটি — zygospore (single, বড়, thick‑wall স্পোর), ascospore (ascus নামক থলির ভিতরে তৈরি হয়), আর basidiospore (basidium নামক pedestal‑এর উপরে তৈরি হয়)।

আর asexual spore (conidia) গুলো?

Asexual conidia গুলো হলো — arthrospore, blastospore, chlamydospore, sporangiospore, microconidia ও macroconidia।

যে fungus sexual spore তৈরি করে না, তাকে কী বলে?

তাকে বলে fungi imperfecti (Deuteromycotina)—অর্থাৎ imperfect fungus, কারণ এর sexual form পাওয়া যায় না।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, মূল পার্থক্যটা হলো — fungal spore হলো exospore, অর্থাৎ reproduction‑এর জন্য, sexual ও asexual দুটোই; আর bacterial spore হলো endospore, অর্থাৎ survival‑এর জন্য — harsh condition (heat, desiccation, radiation)‑এ বাঁচতে সাহায্য করে।

Formation ধরে বলি — fungal spore বাইরে, specialized structure (conidiophore, sporangium, বা hyphae fragmentation) থেকে তৈরি হয়; bacterial endospore ভিতরে, vegetative bacterial cell‑এর intracellular‑এ তৈরি হয়। Number অনুযায়ী — fungus‑এ একটি parent থেকে একসাথে অনেকগুলো spore তৈরি হয়; bacteria‑তে একটি vegetative cell থেকে সাধারণত একটি মাত্র endospore (one spore = one cell)।

Structurally fungal spore simple — single বা few cell, কোনো specialized cortex নেই; bacteria‑র endospore complex — core, cortex ও thick protein coat (spore coat) থাকে। Resistance — fungal spore কিছুটা resistant, কিন্তু bacterial endospore‑এর মতো নয়; endospore heat, chemicals, UV, desiccation‑এ extremely resistant। Germination — fungal spore থেকে নতুন fungal hyphae বা yeast হয়; bacterial endospore থেকে single vegetative cell।

Example — fungal: zygospore, ascospore, basidiospore, conidia, sporangiospore, arthrospore, chlamydospore, blastospore; bacteria: Bacillus, Clostridium endospore। মনে রাখার শর্টকাট — exospore = reproduction, endospore = survival; many spores vs one spore।

M4

Classify fungus morphologically with example. *********

▾
📌 Hint: Yeast, yeast-like, mold, dimorphic — with examples
▾ ✅ Answer

Fungi are morphologically classified into two main forms — yeast and mold — plus two sub-categories: yeast-like and dimorphic.

Morphological TypeDescriptionExamples
a. Yeast Unicellular, round or oval cells. Reproduce by budding. In the body, buds remain attached or detach as new cells. Cryptococcus neoformans (pathogenic), Saccharomyces cerevisiae (non-pathogenic)
b. Yeast-like (pseudohyphae) Unicellular yeast that forms pseudohyphae — elongated cells remaining attached in chains after budding. Candida species (especially C. albicans)
c. Mold Multicellular, elongated filaments called hyphae. Hyphae grow continuously by tip extension, forming a tangled mass called mycelium. Hyphae may be septate or non-septate (coenocytic). Molds grow at room temperature (25°C). Dermatophytes, Aspergillus, Rhizopus, Mucor, Penicillium, Rhinosporidium seeberi
d. Dimorphic Two forms: mold at room temperature (25°C) in environment; yeast at body temperature (37°C) in the host. Histoplasma capsulatum, Blastomyces dermatitidis, Coccidioides immitis, Paracoccidioides brasiliensis, Sporothrix schenckii, Penicillium marneffei, Malassezia furfur
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Septate আর non-septate hyphae—এই দুটো কোন ধরনের fungus‑এ দেখা যায়?

Septate hyphae — cross wall থাকে, বেশিরভাগ pathogenic, dermatophytes ও systemic fungi‑তে দেখা যায়। Non-septate (coenocytic) — cross wall নেই, multinucleated, বেশিরভাগ saprophytic, যেমন Mucor, Penicillium।

Hyphae কীভাবে grow করে?

Hyphae tip‑এর extension দিয়ে grow করে — filament‑এর খুঁএ cell division দিয়ে নয়।

Mycelium কী?

Hyphae‑র visible tangled mass‑কে mycelium বলে — culture‑এ cotton ball‑এর মতো দেখা যায়।

Fungi imperfecti কাকে বলে?

যে fungus sexual spore তৈরি করে না, তাকে fungi imperfecti বা Deuteromycotina বলে।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, morphological classification‑এ মূলত ৪টি group আছে — (ক) yeast, (খ) yeast‑like (pseudohyphae), (গ) mold ও (ঘ) dimorphic।

প্রথম yeast — unicellular, round বা oval cell, budding দিয়ে reproduce করে। শরীরে bud attached থাকে বা নতুন cell হয়ে আলাদা হয়। Example — Cryptococcus neoformans (pathogenic), Saccharomyces cerevisiae (non‑pathogenic)। দ্বিতীয় yeast‑like — unicellular yeast যা pseudohyphae তৈরি করে, অর্থাৎ budding‑এর পর elongated cell chain আকারে attached থাকে। Example — Candida, বিশেষ করে C. albicans।

তৃতীয় mold — multicellular, elongated filament hyphae। Hyphae tip extension দিয়ে grow করে এবং tangled mass হয়ে mycelium তৈরি করে। Hyphae septate বা non‑septate (coenocytic) হতে পারে। Mold 25°C (room temperature)‑এ grow করে। Example — dermatophytes, Aspergillus, Rhizopus, Mucor, Penicillium, Rhinosporidium seeberi।

চতুর্থ dimorphic — দুটি form: environment‑এ 25°C‑এ mold, host‑এ 37°C‑এ yeast। Example — Histoplasma capsulatum, Blastomyces dermatitidis, Coccidioides immitis, Paracoccidioides brasiliensis, Sporothrix schenckii, Penicillium marneffei, Malassezia furfur।

মনে রাখবেন — yeast unicellular + budding, mold multicellular + hyphae/mycelium; dimorphic মানে temperature অনুযায়ী দুই রকম। আর septate hyphae সাধারণত pathogenic, non‑septate saprophytic।

Yeast‑এর কিছু example দিন?

Cryptococcus neoformans ও Saccharomyces cerevisiae — এই দুটি yeast।

Mold‑এর example?

Aspergillus, Mucor, Rhizopus, Penicillium আর dermatophytes।

Yeast‑like fungus মানে কী?

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, yeast আর mold‑এর পার্থক্য তুলনা করে বলছি। Cell number — yeast unicellular, mold multicellular। Shape — yeast round বা oval, mold elongated filament (hyphae)। Reproduction — yeast budding দিয়ে; mold tip extension দিয়ে hyphae grow করে আর spore তৈরি করে।

Structure — yeast single cell, pseudohyphae তৈরি করতে পারে; mold hyphae দিয়ে mycelium (tangled mass) গঠন করে। Colony appearance — yeast smooth, creamy, wet‑looking (bacteria‑র মতো); mold cottony, powdery, velvety বা granular। Growth temperature — yeast 37°C (body temperature), mold 25°C (room temperature)। Microscopy — yeast‑এ budding yeast cell; mold‑এ branched septate বা non‑septate hyphae।

Example হিসেবে remember করুন — yeast: Cryptococcus, Saccharomyces; mold: Aspergillus, Mucor, Rhizopus, Penicillium, dermatophytes। আর yeast‑like Candida pseudohyphae তৈরি করতে পারে, আর dimorphic fungi 25°C‑এ mold, 37°C‑এ yeast হয়।

M6

What do you mean by hyphae, pseudohyphae and mycelium? ***

▾
📌 Hint: Hyphae = filaments; pseudohyphae = chained buds; mycelium = tangled mass of hyphae
▾ ✅ Answer

Hyphae: Long, branching filamentous structures formed by mold. Growth occurs by extension of the tip (not by cell division along the filament). Two types: septate (with cross walls) and non-septate / coenocytic (multinucleated, no cross walls).

  • Septate hyphae: Usually pathogenic — dermatophytes, systemic fungi.
  • Non-septate hyphae: Mostly saprophytic — Mucor, Rhizopus.

Pseudohyphae: Formed in some yeasts (especially Candida) when buds remain attached to the mother cell, forming a chain of elongated cells. They are NOT true hyphae because they lack the continuous cytoplasmic flow seen in true hyphae.

Mycelium: When hyphae grow continuously and form a tangled mass or mat of growth, it is called mycelium. This is visible to the naked eye and gives mold colonies their characteristic cottony/powdery appearance.

▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Pseudohyphae Candida albicans‑এর জন্য কেন characteristic?

কারণ C. albicans budding‑এর পর elongated cell‑এর chain আকারে pseudohyphae তৈরি করে — এটা এর একটি distinctive morphological feature।

Culture‑এ mycelium terminology কীভাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়?

SDA plate‑এ যে visible "fuzzy" বা cottony growth দেখা যায়, সেটাই aerial mycelium।

Hyphae microscope‑এ কীভাবে পরীক্ষা করা হয়?

KOH preparation বা Lactophenol Cotton Blue staining‑এর পরে পরীক্ষা করা হয়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, তিনটি term পরিষ্কার করে বলছি।

Hyphae — mold‑এর তৈরি long, branching filamentous structure। Hyphae tip‑এর extension দিয়ে grow করে, cell division দিয়ে নয়। দুই প্রকার — septate (cross wall আছে) ও non‑septate / coenocytic (multinucleated, cross wall নেই)। Septate সাধারণত pathogenic — dermatophytes, systemic fungi; non‑septate বেশিরভাগ saprophytic — Mucor, Rhizopus।

Pseudohyphae — কিছু yeast‑এ (বিশেষত Candida) bud মাদার cell‑এ attached থাকলে elongated cell‑এর chain তৈরি হয় — এটাই pseudohyphae। এটা true hyphae নয়, কারণ true hyphae‑র মতো continuous cytoplasmic flow থাকে না।

Mycelium — hyphae যখন ক্রমাগত grow করে tangled mass বা mat তৈরি করে, তখন তাকে mycelium বলে। এটা naked eye‑এ visible, আর mold colony‑র cottony/powdery appearance‑এর কারণ।

Microscopically hyphae KOH preparation বা Lactophenol Cotton Blue staining দিয়ে দেখা হয়।

M7

Classify fungus according to habitat. ***

▾
📌 Hint: Superficial cutaneous, subcutaneous, systemic, opportunistic
▾ ✅ Answer

Clinical classification based on site of infection / habitat:

A. Superficial Cutaneous Fungi — affect skin, hair, nails; confined to body surfaces.

  • Malassezia furfur — tinea versicolor
  • Dermatophytes (Epidermophyton, Trichophyton, Microsporum) — dermatophytosis / tinea / ringworm
  • Trichosporon beigelii — white piedra
  • Piedraia hortae — black piedra
  • Hortaea werneckii — tinea nigra
  • Candida albicans (sometimes) — superficial candidiasis

B. Subcutaneous Fungi — inoculated through skin by cuts, scratches, or thorns.

  • Sporothrix schenckii — sporotrichosis (rose handler disease)
  • Rhinosporidium seeberi — rhinosporidiosis
  • Madurella mycetomatis — mycetoma / madura foot
  • Dematiaceous fungi (Fonsecaea, Phialophora, Exophiala, Cladosporium) — chromoblastomycosis & pheohyphomycosis

C. Systemic / Deep Fungi — usually dimorphic; affect internal organs.

  • Histoplasma capsulatum — histoplasmosis
  • Blastomyces dermatitidis — blastomycosis
  • Coccidioides immitis — coccidioidomycosis
  • Paracoccidioides brasiliensis — paracoccidioidomycosis

D. Opportunistic Fungi — cause disease in immunocompromised individuals.

  • Candida albicans — candidiasis
  • Cryptococcus neoformans — cryptococcal meningitis
  • Pneumocystis jiroveci — pneumocystis pneumonia
  • Aspergillus fumigatus — aspergillosis
  • Mucor & Rhizopus — mucormycosis (black fungus)
  • Penicillium marneffei — penicilliosis
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

কোন fungi নিঃসন্দেহে superficial, আর কোনগুলো cutaneous?

Malassezia furfur ও dermatophytes নিঃসন্দেহে superficial; Candida ও dermatophytes‑কে superficial group‑এর মধ্যেই cutaneous হিসেবেও ধরা হয়।

Subcutaneous fungi কীভাবে infection তৈরি করে?

Skin‑এর thorn, splinter বা ছোটখাটো trauma‑এর মাধ্যমে inoculation হয়ে সংক্রমণ হয়।

Systemic fungi সাধারণত কেমন হয়?

সাধারণত dimorphic — environment‑এ mold, host‑এ yeast।

Aspergillus‑এর বিশেষত্ব কী?

Aspergillus হলো এমন একটি opportunistic fungus যা আবার moldও বটে, এবং এর septate hyphae থাকে।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, habitat অনুযায়ী classification‑এ ৪টি group আছে — A. Superficial Cutaneous, B. Subcutaneous, C. Systemic/Deep ও D. Opportunistic।

A. Superficial Cutaneous Fungi — skin, hair, nail‑কে প্রভাবিত করে, body surface‑এ সীমাবদ্ধ। Example — Malassezia furfur (tinea versicolor), dermatophytes (Epidermophyton, Trichophyton, Microsporum) — dermatophytosis/tinea/ringworm, Trichosporon beigelii (white piedra), Piedraia hortae (black piedra), Hortaea werneckii (tinea nigra), আর কখনো Candida albicans (superficial candidiasis)।

B. Subcutaneous Fungi — cut, scratch বা thorn দিয়ে skin‑এর inoculation হয়। Example — Sporothrix schenckii (sporotrichosis/rose handler disease), Rhinosporidium seeberi (rhinosporidiosis), Madurella mycetomatis (mycetoma/madura foot), আর dematiaceous fungi (Fonsecaea, Phialophora, Exophiala, Cladosporium) — chromoblastomycosis & pheohyphomycosis।

C. Systemic / Deep Fungi — সাধারণত dimorphic, internal organ প্রভাবিত করে। Example — Histoplasma capsulatum (histoplasmosis), Blastomyces dermatitidis (blastomycosis), Coccidioides immitis (coccidioidomycosis), Paracoccidioides brasiliensis (paracoccidioidomycosis)।

D. Opportunistic Fungi — immunocompromised ব্যক্তিদের disease করে। Example — Candida albicans (candidiasis), Cryptococcus neoformans (cryptococcal meningitis), Pneumocystis jiroveci (pneumocystis pneumonia), Aspergillus fumigatus (aspergillosis), Mucor & Rhizopus (mucormycosis/black fungus), Penicillium marneffei (penicilliosis)।

M8

Define dimorphic fungus with example. *********

▾
📌 Hint: Mold at 25°C, yeast at 37°C — remember the main dimorphic fungi
▾ ✅ Answer

Dimorphic fungi are fungi that exist in two forms depending on temperature: they grow as molds (hyphae) at room temperature (25°C) in the environment and as yeast at body temperature (37°C) in human tissues. This property is called thermal dimorphism.

The mnemonic: "Mold at 25, Yeast at 37 — the lung fungi!"

Examples of dimorphic fungi:

  • Histoplasma capsulatum — histoplasmosis
  • Blastomyces dermatitidis — blastomycosis
  • Coccidioides immitis — coccidioidomycosis
  • Paracoccidioides brasiliensis — paracoccidioidomycosis
  • Sporothrix schenckii — sporotrichosis
  • Penicillium marneffei — penicilliosis
  • Malassezia furfur — tinea versicolor
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Dimorphic fungus‑এর pathogenesis কীভাবে?

Environment থেকে mold spore inhale হয় → lung‑এ গিয়ে spore yeast‑এ differentiate করে → বেশিরভাগ infection asymptomatic ও self‑limited, কিন্তু disseminate করলে রোগ হতে পারে।

কোন fungi‑তে dimorphism বেশি দেখা যায়?

সব systemic/deep fungi সাধারণত dimorphic হয়ে থাকে।

Mold থেকে yeast‑এ রূপান্তর কেন virulence factor?

কারণ yeast form শরীরে macrophage‑এর ভিতরেও survive করতে পারে — এটাই আসল virulence factor।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, dimorphic fungi হলো সেই fungus যারা temperature অনুযায়ী দুই রকম form‑এ থাকে — environment‑এ 25°C‑এ mold (hyphae), আর human tissue‑এ 37°C‑এ yeast। এই বৈশিষ্ট্যকে বলে thermal dimorphism। Mnemonic — "Mold at 25, Yeast at 37 — the lung fungi!"

Example — Histoplasma capsulatum (histoplasmosis), Blastomyces dermatitidis (blastomycosis), Coccidioides immitis (coccidioidomycosis), Paracoccidioides brasiliensis (paracoccidioidomycosis), Sporothrix schenckii (sporotrichosis), Penicillium marneffei (penicilliosis), আর Malassezia furfur (tinea versicolor)।

Pathogenesis‑উলটা বললে — environment থেকে mold spore inhale হয়, lung‑এ গিয়ে yeast‑এ convert হয়। বেশিরভাগ infection asymptomatic, self‑limited; তবে disseminate করলে নানা disease হতে পারে। সব systemic/deep fungi সাধারণত dimorphic। আর mold→yeast এই transition‑টা একটা key virulence factor, কারণ yeast form macrophage‑এর ভিতরে survive করতে পারে।

M9

What do you mean by dermatophytes? Mention the dermatophytes and their site of infection. *****

▾
📌 Hint: Keratinophilic fungi; infect skin, hair, nails
▾ ✅ Answer

Dermatophytes are a group of fungi that infect only superficial keratinized tissues — the skin and skin appendages such as hair and nails. They are keratinophilic, meaning they thrive on keratin.

Keratin types in different structures:

  • Skin — soft keratin
  • Hair — hard and soft keratin
  • Nail — hard keratin
GenusSpeciesSite of Infection
EpidermophytonE. floccosumSkin & Nail
TrichophytonT. rubrumSkin, Hair & Nail
T. tonsuransSkin, Hair & Nail
T. mentagrophytesSkin, Hair & Nail
T. schoenleinii, T. verrucosumSkin, Hair & Nail
MicrosporumM. canisSkin & Hair
M. gypseumSkin & Hair

Key point: Epidermophyton does NOT infect hair; Microsporum does NOT infect nails; Trichophyton infects all three.

▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Dermatophytosis কীভাবে ছড়ায় (transmission)?

Direct contact — infected person থেকে (anthropophilic), infected animal থেকে যেমন dog/cat (zoophilic — প্রধানত Microsporum), আর indirect contact — shared clothing, comb, towel দিয়ে।

এই রোগকে আর কী কী নামে ডাকা হয়?

Dermatophytosis / tinea / ringworm infection নামে ডাকা হয়।

Tinea কীভাবে body area অনুযায়ী নাম পায়?

Tinea capitis (head hair), tinea corporis (trunk), tinea cruris (groin), tinea pedis (foot), tinea unguium (nail), tinea manuum (hand), tinea barbae (beard), tinea faciei (face)।

Microconidia‑র shape কী কী?

T. rubrum — single, tear drop; T. mentagrophytes — cluster, oval; T. tonsurans — elongated।

আর macroconidia‑র shape?

Epidermophyton — club shaped; Trichophyton — cylindrical; Microsporum — spindle shaped।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, dermatophytes হলো সেই fungi যারা শুধু superficial keratinized tissue‑কে infect করে — skin আর তার appendage, যেমন hair ও nail। এরা keratinophilic, অর্থাৎ keratin‑এ বেঁচে থাকে।

Keratin type — skin‑এ soft keratin, hair‑এ hard ও soft keratin, nail‑এ hard keratin। তিনটি genus — Epidermophyton, Trichophyton, Microsporum। E. floccosum শুধু skin & nail‑এ infect করে। Trichophyton‑এর species গুলো (rubrum, tonsurans, mentagrophytes, schoenleinii, verrucosum) skin, hair ও nail — তিনটিতেই infect করে। Microsporum (canis, gypseum) শুধু skin & hair infect করে।

Key point — Epidermophyton hair infect করে না, Microsporum nail infect করে না, Trichophyton তিনটিই infect করে।

Transmission — direct contact: infected person (anthropophilic) বা infected animal (zoophilic — যেমন Microsporum), আর indirect — shared clothing, comb, towel। রোগের নাম dermatophytosis/tinea/ringworm। Site অনুযায়ী — tinea capitis (head), corporis (trunk), cruris (groin), pedis (foot), unguium (nail), manuum (hand), barbae (beard), faciei (face)। Identification — microconidia: T. rubrum single tear drop, T. mentagrophytes cluster oval, T. tonsurans elongated; macroconidia: Epidermophyton club, Trichophyton cylindrical, Microsporum spindle।

M10

Write down the methods of laboratory diagnosis of fungal infections/dermatophytoses/ring worm infections. ***********

▾
📌 Hint: KOH prep, culture on SDA, staining, PCR, Wood's lamp, hair perforation test
▾ ✅ Answer

1. Specimen Collection:

  • Skin scraping (from margin of lesion and redness area)
  • Nail clipping
  • Hair plucking
  • Swabs (oral, throat, vaginal) for Candida
  • Blood (for serology in systemic mycosis)

2. Microscopical Examination:

  • KOH wet mount preparation (most common): KOH 10–40% dissolves keratin → fungi visualized after 30 min. Findings: skin/nail — branching septate hyphae (± arthrospore); hair — ectothrix or endothrix.
  • Staining: Calcofluor white (most common), Lactophenol cotton blue (for culture mount), Indian ink (for Cryptococcus capsule), Gram stain (only for Candida — shows gram-positive yeast), Methenamine silver, PAS, Giemsa, H&E.

3. Culture / Isolation and Identification:

  • SDA (Sabouraud's Dextrose Agar) — most common media.
  • Mold: incubate at 25°C for 2–4 weeks. Yeast: at 37°C for 2–4 weeks.
  • Naked eye: colony color (white, brown, greenish-yellow), texture (powdery, cottony, velvety, granular).
  • Microscopy of culture: stain with lactophenol cotton blue → macroconidia & microconidia morphology.
  • Other media: SDA + chloramphenicol & cycloheximide, dermatophyte test agar, potato dextrose agar, corn meal agar, mycobiotic agar.

4. Immunological Tests: Antigen detection & antibody detection (mainly for systemic mycosis; not usually for dermatophytosis).

5. Molecular Detection: PCR.

6. Other Tests:

  • Wood's lamp: Microsporum species show fluorescence under UV — used for tinea capitis.
  • Hair perforation test: For Microsporum & Trichophyton.
  • Skin test: For systemic fungi, dermatophytes, Sporothrix, and Candida.
  • Germ tube test: Differentiates C. albicans from other Candida species.
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Superficial cutaneous fungus‑এ KOH কেন, আর অন্য body fluid‑এ কী ব্যবহার হয়?

Superficial cutaneous fungus‑এ KOH keratin dissolve করে, তাই fungus স্পষ্ট দেখা যায়; অন্য body fluid‑এ (যেমন blood, CSF) normal saline wet mount ব্যবহার হয়।

Macroconidia দিয়ে কীভাবে identify করা হয়?

Epidermophyton — club shaped; Trichophyton — cylindrical; Microsporum — spindle shaped।

আর microconidia দিয়ে?

T. rubrum — single tear drop; T. mentagrophytes — cluster oval; T. tonsurans — elongated।

সব fungus‑এ Gram stain ব্যবহার করা যায় কি?

না — শুধু Candida‑র জন্য Gram stain useful; অন্য fungus‑এ নয়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, fungal infection‑এর lab diagnosis ধাপে ধাপে বলছি।

১. Specimen collection: skin scraping (lesion margin ও redness area থেকে), nail clipping, hair plucking; Candida‑র জন্য oral/throat/vaginal swab; systemic mycosis‑এ serology‑র জন্য blood।

২. Microscopical examination: সবচেয়ে common KOH wet mount — KOH 10–40% keratin dissolve করে, 30 min পরে fungus দেখা যায়। Finding — skin/nail‑এ branching septate hyphae (± arthrospore), hair‑এ ectothrix বা endothrix। Staining — Calcofluor white (most common), Lactophenol cotton blue (culture mount), Indian ink (Cryptococcus capsule), Gram stain (শুধু Candida — gram‑positive yeast), Methenamine silver, PAS, Giemsa, H&E।

৩. Culture/isolation: common media SDA। Mold 25°C‑এ 2–4 week, yeast 37°C‑এ 2–4 week। Naked eye‑এ colony color/texture দেখি, তারপর lactophenol cotton blue দিয়ে macro‑ ও microconidia morphology। Onno media — SDA + chloramphenicol & cycloheximide, dermatophyte test agar, potato dextrose agar, corn meal agar, mycobiotic agar।

৪. Immunological test — antigen ও antibody detection, মূলত systemic mycosis‑এ। ৫. Molecular — PCR। ৬. Other tests — Wood's lamp: Microsporum UV‑তে fluoresce করে (tinea capitis); hair perforation test: Microsporum & Trichophyton; skin test: systemic fungi, dermatophytes, Sporothrix, Candida; germ tube test: C. albicans আর অন্য Candida আলাদা করে।

M11

S/N: Mycotoxin. ***

▾
📌 Hint: Fungal toxins that cause mycotoxicosis
▾ ✅ Answer

Mycotoxins are toxins released by certain fungi as they grow. Mycotoxicosis is the condition caused by ingestion of these fungal toxins.

MycotoxinProducing FungusEffect (Mycotoxicosis)
AmanitinAmanita mushroomsLiver damage
PhalloidinAmanita mushroomsLiver damage
ErgotamineClaviceps purpureaErgotism (vascular & neurological damage)
LSD (Lysergic acid diethylamide)Claviceps purpureaErgotism (vascular & neurological damage)
AflatoxinsAspergillus flavusLiver damage & liver carcinoma
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Aflatoxin দিয়ে hepatocellular carcinoma কীভাবে হয় — pathway বলুন?

Spoiled grain/peanut‑এর সাথে aflatoxin খাওয়া হয় → liver metabolize করে → epoxide তৈরি করে (একটি potent carcinogen) → p53 tumour suppressor gene‑এ mutation → p53 protein‑এর loss → hepatocellular carcinoma।

Amanita mushroom কতগুলো toxin তৈরি করে?

Amanita mushroom মোট পাঁচটি ভিন্ন toxin produce করে।

Ergotism‑এর উপসর্গ কী কী?

Ergotism vascular spasm ও neurological — দুই ধরনের damage‑ই করতে পারে।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, mycotoxin হলো সেই toxin যা কিছু fungus grow করার সময় release করে। Mycotoxicosis হলো সেই অবস্থা যা এই fungal toxin খাওয়ার ফলে হয়।

Amanitin ও Phalloidin — দুটোই Amanita mushroom থেকে; effect — liver damage। Ergotamine ও LSD (Lysergic acid diethylamide) — দুটোই Claviceps purpurea থেকে; effect — ergotism (vascular & neurological damage)। Aflatoxins — Aspergillus flavus থেকে; effect — liver damage ও liver carcinoma।

Aflatoxin‑এর mechanism — spoiled grain/peanut → aflatoxin → liver metabolize → epoxide (potent carcinogen) → p53 tumour suppressor gene‑এ mutation → p53 protein loss → hepatocellular carcinoma। মনে রাখবেন — Amanita mushroom পাঁচটি আলাদা toxin produce করে, আর ergotism vascular ও neurological দুটো ধরনের damage‑ই করে।

M12

Name five fungal culture media. ***** (SDA, mycobiotic media, dermatophyte test media, corn meal media)

▾
📌 Hint: SDA, mycobiotic media, dermatophyte test media, corn meal media
▾ ✅ Answer

Five important fungal culture media:

  1. Sabouraud's Dextrose Agar (SDA) — most commonly used fungal culture media.
  2. Mycobiotic (Fungobiotic) Agar Media
  3. Dermatophyte Test Agar (DTA) Media
  4. Corn Meal Agar Media
  5. Potato Dextrose Agar Media

SDA details:

  • High dextrose content — excellent carbon & energy source.
  • Peptone — source of nitrogen, vitamins, and minerals.
  • Acidic pH (5.6) — optimal for fungi, not bacteria.
  • Antibiotics frequently added: penicillin (kills gram-positive bacteria), streptomycin (kills gram-negative bacteria), cycloheximide (inhibits saprophytic/non-pathogenic fungi).
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

আর কোন কোন fungal media আছে?

SDA + chloramphenicol & cycloheximide, inhibitory mold agar, blood agar with antibiotic, brain heart infusion agar।

SDA‑তে bacteria কেন grow করে না?

তিনটি কারণ — acidic pH (bacteria pH 7 পছন্দ করে), antibiotic যোগ করা হয়, আর high dextrose osmotic pressure বাড়ায়, যা bacteria inhibit করে।

Culture time কত?

Mold 25°C‑এ 2–4 weeks; yeast 37°C‑এ 2–4 weeks।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, পাঁচটি fungal culture media বলছি।

  1. Sabouraud's Dextrose Agar (SDA) — সবচেয়ে বেশি ব্যবহৃত fungal culture media।
  2. Mycobiotic (Fungobiotic) Agar
  3. Dermatophyte Test Agar (DTA)
  4. Corn Meal Agar
  5. Potato Dextrose Agar

SDA‑র details — high dextrose (excellent carbon/energy source); peptone (nitrogen, vitamin, mineral source); acidic pH 5.6 — fungus‑এর optimum, bacteria‑র নয়; আর antibiotic যোগ হয় — penicillin gram‑positive bacteria মারে, streptomycin gram‑negative bacteria মারে, cycloheximide saprophytic/non‑pathogenic fungus inhibit করে।

SDA‑তে bacteria না ওঠার কারণ — acidic pH, antibiotic, আর high dextrose‑র osmotic pressure। Culture time — mold 25°C 2–4 week, yeast 37°C 2–4 week। আরও media — SDA + chloramphenicol & cycloheximide, inhibitory mold agar, blood agar with antibiotic, brain heart infusion agar।

M13

Name three common fungal staining methods. ***** (calcoflour white ***, lactophenol cotton blue ***, indian ink, methenamine silver stain, gram staining, giemsa stain)

▾
📌 Hint: Calcofluor white, lactophenol cotton blue, Indian ink, methenamine silver, Gram stain, Giemsa
▾ ✅ Answer

Three most common fungal stains:

  1. Calcofluor White — a fluorescent stain that binds to chitin and cellulose in fungal cell walls. Used for direct visualization of fungi in clinical specimens.
  2. Lactophenol Cotton Blue (LPCB) — the most common stain for examining fungal cultures. Cotton blue stains the chitin in fungal walls; lactic acid preserves fungal structures; phenol acts as a disinfectant.
  3. Indian Ink — a negative capsular stain used to visualize the wide unstained capsule of Cryptococcus neoformans. The capsule appears as a clear halo against a dark background.

Other important stains:

  • Gram stain — only for Candida (shows gram-positive yeast).
  • Giemsa stain — histopathological stain; also used for blood films.
  • Methenamine Silver (GMS) — histopathological stain for fungi in tissue sections.
  • PAS (Periodic Acid Schiff) — stains fungal polysaccharides magenta.
  • H&E (Hematoxylin & Eosin) — general tissue stain.
  • Fluorescent antibody staining
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

রুটিন fungal identification‑এ সবচেয়ে common কোন দুটি stain?

Calcofluor white আর LPCB — এই দুটোই routine fungal identification‑এ সবচেয়ে common।

Indian ink rapid test কীভাবে করা হয়?

এক ফোঁটা CSF + Indian ink → microscope‑এ দেখুন → encapsulated budding yeast দেখা যায়।

Gram stain কি সব fungus‑এ useful?

না — Candida ছাড়া Gram stain fungus‑এর জন্য সাধারণত useful নয়; Candida‑তে gram‑positive oval yeast দেখা যায়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, তিনটি common fungal stain বলছি।

  1. Calcofluor White — fluorescent stain, fungal cell wall‑এর chitin ও cellulose‑এর সাথে binds হয়। Clinical specimen‑এ fungus সরাসরি দেখার জন্য।
  2. Lactophenol Cotton Blue (LPCB) — fungal culture পরীক্ষার সবচেয়ে common stain। Cotton blue chitin‑কে color করে; lactic acid fungal structure preserve করে; phenol disinfectant হিসেবে কাজ করে।
  3. Indian Ink — negative capsular stain, Cryptococcus neoformans‑এর wide unstained capsule দেখার জন্য। Capsule dark background‑এ clear halo হিসাবে দেখা যায়।

অন্য important stains — Gram stain (শুধু Candida — gram‑positive yeast), Giemsa (histopathological + blood film), Methenamine Silver (GMS) (tissue section‑এ fungus), PAS (fungal polysaccharide‑কে magenta করে), H&E (সাধারণ tissue stain), আর fluorescent antibody staining।

রুটিনে Calcofluor white ও LPCB সবচেয়ে common; Indian ink rapid — CSF + ink দিয়ে encapsulated budding yeast দেখা যায়; আর Gram stain শুধু Candida‑তে useful।

M14

Why KOH is used in fungal wet mount preparation? ********* (to dissolve the keratin layer, easy visualization of fungus)

▾
📌 Hint: To dissolve the keratin layer, easy visualization of fungus
▾ ✅ Answer

KOH (Potassium Hydroxide) is used in fungal wet mount preparation because:

  • Dissolves keratin: KOH (10–40%) dissolves the keratin present in skin, hair, and nail specimens. This removes the obscuring host tissue debris that would otherwise hide the fungal elements.
  • Easy visualization of fungi: After keratin dissolution, the refractile fungal hyphae, spores, and other structures become clearly visible under the microscope.
  • KOH does NOT dissolve chitin — the fungal cell wall component — so fungi remain intact while the surrounding host tissue is cleared.

Procedure: Place specimen on slide → add KOH (10–40%) → wait 30 minutes → examine under microscope with or without staining.

Note: For specimens from non-skin sites (e.g. blood, CSF), normal saline wet mount is used instead of KOH.

▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Fungal lab diagnosis‑এ KOH wet mount কতটা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ?

Fungal lab diagnosis‑এর most common ও first‑line preparation হলো এটাই।

KOH preparation‑এ কী finding দেখা যায়?

Skin/nail scraping‑এ branching septate hyphae (± arthrospore); hair‑এ ectothrix বা endothrix।

Wait time কত, আর কী দিয়ে কমানো যায়?

Typical wait time 30 minutes; slide গরম করলে clearing দ্রুত হয়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, KOH (Potassium Hydroxide) fungal wet mount‑এ ব্যবহার হয় কারণ —

  • Keratin dissolve করে: KOH 10–40% skin, hair, nail‑এর keratin dissolve করে, ফলে সেই host tissue debris সরে যায় যা না হলে fungus‑কে লুকিয়ে রাখত।
  • Fungus সহজে দেখা যায়: keratin dissolve‑এর পর refractile fungal hyphae, spore ইত্যাদি microscope‑এ স্পষ্ট দেখা যায়।
  • KOH chitin dissolve করে না — fungal cell wall‑এর উপাদান chitin intact থাকে, তাই fungus বাঁচে, শুধু চারপাশের host tissue clear হয়।

Procedure — specimen slide‑এ → KOH 10–40% যোগ → 30 min wait → staining সহ বা ছাড়া microscope‑এ দেখুন। Note — non‑skin site (blood, CSF)‑এ KOH নয়, normal saline wet mount ব্যবহার হয়।

এটা fungal lab diagnosis‑এর most common ও first‑line preparation। Finding — skin/nail‑এ branching septate hyphae (+ arthrospore), hair‑এ ectothrix/endothrix।

M15

Why SDA media is used to diagnosed fungus? *** (acidic pH optimum for fungus not for bacteria, high sugar conc.: fungus is a sugar loving organism, added antibiotics: prevent bacterial growth)

▾
📌 Hint: Acidic pH optimum for fungus not for bacteria, high sugar conc., added antibiotics
▾ ✅ Answer

Sabouraud's Dextrose Agar (SDA) is the most commonly used media for fungal diagnosis because of three key properties:

  1. Acidic pH (5.6): Optimal for fungal growth. Most bacteria prefer neutral pH (~7.0) and cannot grow well at this acidic pH — so fungi are selectively encouraged while bacteria are inhibited.
  2. High dextrose (glucose) concentration: Provides an excellent source of carbon and energy. Fungi are sugar-loving organisms (saccharophilic). The high sugar also raises osmotic pressure, which inhibits many bacteria.
  3. Added antibiotics: Penicillin (inhibits gram-positive bacteria), streptomycin (inhibits gram-negative bacteria), and cycloheximide (inhibits saprophytic/non-pathogenic fungi) are frequently added to further ensure only pathogenic fungi grow.

Additional components: Peptone provides nitrogen, vitamins, and minerals.

▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

SDA‑তে culture time কত?

Mold 25°C‑এ 2–4 weeks; yeast 37°C‑এ 2–4 weeks।

অন্য fungal media গুলো কী কী?

SDA + chloramphenicol & cycloheximide, mycobiotic agar, dermatophyte test agar, potato dextrose agar, corn meal agar।

Cycloheximide‑এর বিশেষ কাজ কী?

Cycloheximide বিশেষভাবে saprophytic (non‑pathogenic) fungi‑কে inhibit করে, যাতে clinical specimen থেকে pathogenic fungus select হয়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, SDA fungal diagnosis‑এর সবচেয়ে common media, আর এর কারণ তিনটি key property।

  1. Acidic pH (5.6): fungal growth‑এর optimum। Most bacteria neutral pH (~7.0) পছন্দ করে, তাই এই acidic pH‑এ গজাতে পারে না — fungi selectively বাড়ে, bacteria inhibit হয়।
  2. High dextrose concentration: carbon ও energy‑র excellent source। Fungi হলো sugar‑loving (saccharophilic) organism। High sugar osmotic pressure‑ও বাড়ায়, ফলে অনেক bacteria‑ও inhibit হয়।
  3. Antibiotic যোগ: penicillin (gram‑positive bacteria inhibit), streptomycin (gram‑negative bacteria inhibit), cycloheximide (saprophytic/non‑pathogenic fungus inhibit) — যাতে শুধু pathogenic fungus‑ই grow করে।

আরেকটি component — peptone, যা nitrogen, vitamin ও mineral দেয়। Culture time — mold 25°C 2–4 week, yeast 37°C 2–4 week। আরও media আছে — SDA + chloramphenicol & cycloheximide, mycobiotic agar, DTA, PDA, corn meal agar। Cycloheximide‑র ভূমিকা — saprophytic fungus inhibit করে pathogenic fungus select করা।

M16

Name four (04) systemic mycotic agents. **** (remember the main dimorphic fungus)

▾
📌 Hint: Remember the main dimorphic fungi
▾ ✅ Answer

Four systemic (deep) mycotic agents — all are dimorphic fungi:

Systemic FungusDiseaseMicroscopyTransmission
Histoplasma capsulatumHistoplasmosisYeast within macrophagesInhalation
Blastomyces dermatitidisBlastomycosisYeast with single broad-based budInhalation of microconidia
Coccidioides immitisCoccidioidomycosisSpherule filled with endosporesInhalation of arthrospores
Paracoccidioides brasiliensisParacoccidioidomycosisYeast with multiple buds ("ship captain's wheel")Inhalation
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Systemic mycosis‑এর pathogenesis কীভাবে?

Spore inhalation → lung‑এ yeast differentiation → বেশিরভাগ asymptomatic ও self‑limited; disseminate করলে tissue destruction এমনকি death‑ও হতে পারে।

H. capsulatum macrophage‑এর ভিতর কীভাবে বাঁচে?

Phagolysosome‑এর ভিতরে bicarbonate ও ammonia দিয়ে pH বাড়িয়ে survive করে।

B. dermatitidis আর C. neoformans‑এর bud দিয়ে পার্থক্য কী?

B. dermatitidis‑এর broad‑based bud, আর C. neoformans‑এর narrow‑based bud — এটাই key differentiator।

C. immitis‑এর tissue ও environment form কী?

Lung tissue‑এ spherule with endospores; environment‑এ arthrospore।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, systemic (deep) mycotic agent চারটি, আর সবগুলোই dimorphic fungi।

  1. Histoplasma capsulatum — histoplasmosis; microscopy — yeast within macrophage; transmission — inhalation।
  2. Blastomyces dermatitidis — blastomycosis; single broad‑based bud –যুক্ত yeast; transmission — inhalation of microconidia।
  3. Coccidioides immitis — coccidioidomycosis; spherule filled with endospores; transmission — inhalation of arthrospores।
  4. Paracoccidioides brasiliensis — paracoccidioidomycosis; multiple buds ("ship captain's wheel"); transmission — inhalation।

Pathogenesis — spore inhalation → lung‑এ yeast differentiation → বেশিরভাগ asymptomatic/self‑limited; disseminate করলে tissue destruction বা death। বিশেষ কথা — H. capsulatum phagolysosome‑এর ভিতরে bicarbonate ও ammonia দিয়ে pH বাড়িয়ে বাঁচে; bud morphologically B. dermatitidis broad‑based, C. neoformans narrow‑based; C. immitis tissue‑এ spherule, environment‑এ arthrospore।

M17

Name five (05) opportunistic mycotic agents. *****

▾
📌 Hint: Candida, Cryptococcus, Aspergillus, Pneumocystis, Mucor/Rhizopus
▾ ✅ Answer

Opportunistic fungi normally do not cause disease in healthy individuals but cause infection when the immune system is weakened or impaired.

Five important opportunistic mycotic agents:

Opportunistic FungusDiseaseMorphology
Candida albicansCandidiasisYeast with pseudohyphae
Cryptococcus neoformansCryptococcal meningitis / cryptococcosisYeast with large capsule
Aspergillus fumigatusAspergillosisMold with septate hyphae, V-shaped branches
Mucor & RhizopusMucormycosis (black fungus)Mold with non-septate hyphae
Pneumocystis jiroveciPneumocystis pneumoniaCysts (difficult to culture)

Penicillium marneffei is also an important opportunistic agent (penicilliosis).

▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Most common opportunistic fungus কোনটি?

C. albicans — সবচেয়ে common opportunistic fungus, আর nosocomial fungal infection‑এর সবচেয়ে common কারণও।

C. neoformans‑এর বিশেষত্ব কী?

এটাই একমাত্র capsulated fungus; transmission — inhalation; source — pigeon droppings।

Aspergillus‑এর morphology?

Septate hyphae, dichotomous (V‑shaped) branching; green conidia radiating chain‑এ।

Mucor/Rhizopus‑এর morphology?

Non‑septate hyphae, right‑angle branching; spore sporangium‑এর ভিতরে।

P. jiroveci‑র culture ও diagnosis note কী?

Culture difficult; methenamine silver বা Giemsa stain দিয়ে diagnosis; ELISA শুধু epidemiological উদ্দেশ্যে।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, opportunistic fungi হলো সেইসব fungus যারা healthy মানুষে disease করে না, কিন্তু immune system weakened/impaired হলে infection করে।

পাঁচটি important agent — Candida albicans (candidiasis; yeast with pseudohyphae), Cryptococcus neoformans (cryptococcal meningitis/cryptococcosis; yeast with large capsule), Aspergillus fumigatus (aspergillosis; mold, septate hyphae, V‑shaped branch), Mucor & Rhizopus (mucormycosis/black fungus; mold, non‑septate hyphae), Pneumocystis jiroveci (pneumocystis pneumonia; cysts, culture difficult)। Penicillium marneffei‑ও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ opportunistic agent (penicilliosis)।

High‑yield দিক — C. albicans সবচেয়ে common opportunistic fungus ও nosocomial fungal infection‑এর কারণ; C. neoformans একমাত্র capsulated fungus, source pigeon droppings, transmission inhalation; Aspergillus‑এর dichotomous V‑shaped branching ও green conidia; Mucor/Rhizopus‑এর non‑septate hyphae ও right‑angle branching; P. jiroveci diagnosis methenamine silver/Giemsa, ELISA শুধু epidemiological উদ্দেশ্যে।

M18

Enumerate the fungi that can be present as normal flora. ** (Candida spp)

▾
📌 Hint: Candida spp
▾ ✅ Answer

Candida species (especially C. albicans) are the only fungi found as normal flora in the human body. They colonize:

  • Gastrointestinal tract (GIT)
  • Upper Respiratory Tract
  • Female genital tract

Candida albicans is the most common opportunistic fungus. As a normal commensal, it causes disease when host defenses are weakened — making it an opportunistic pathogen.

▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

C. albicans‑কে কেন "white fungus" বলা হয়?

কারণ oral thrush‑এ white patches (pseudomembrane) দেখা যায়।

Infant‑এ transmission কীভাবে হয়?

Vertical transmission — birth‑এর সময় heavily colonized birth canal দিয়ে।

অন্য কোন Candida species আছে?

C. tropicalis, C. parapsilosis, C. glabrata, C. krusei, C. dubliniensis।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, মানবদেহে Candida species (বিশেষ করে C. albicans)‑ই একমাত্র fungus যা normal flora হিসেবে থাকে। এরা colonize করে — GIT, উপরের respiratory tract আর female genital tract‑এ।

Candida albicans হলো সবচেয়ে common opportunistic fungus। Normal commensal হিসেবে host defense দুর্বল হলে disease করে — তাই এটা opportunistic pathogen।

"White fungus" বলা হয় oral thrush‑এর white patches (pseudomembrane)‑এর কারণে। Infant‑এ transmission vertical — birth canal দিয়ে। আরও species আছে — C. tropicalis, parapsilosis, glabrata, krusei, dubliniensis।

M19

Enumerate the fungi that can take gram stain. ** (Candida take gram positive stain)

▾
📌 Hint: Candida takes gram positive stain
▾ ✅ Answer

Candida species (especially C. albicans) are the only fungi that take up Gram stain. They stain Gram-positive, appearing as gram-positive oval budding yeast cells and pseudohyphae.

Gram stain is generally NOT useful for other fungi — dermatophytes, Aspergillus, Mucor, Cryptococcus, etc. do not take Gram stain reliably.

▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Gram stain‑এ gram‑positive yeast with pseudohyphae দেখলে এর তাৎপর্য কী?

এটা candidiasis‑এর জন্য suggestive — অর্থাৎ Candida infection থাকতে পারে।

অন্য fungus‑এর জন্য কোন stain ব্যবহার হয়?

Specialized stain — calcofluor white, Lactophenol cotton blue, বা Indian ink।

Cryptococcus‑এর diagnosis কোন stain দিয়ে?

Indian ink (negative stain) দিয়ে — Gram stain নয়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, শুধু মাত্র Candida species (বিশেষ করে C. albicans)‑ই Gram stain গ্রহণ করে, আর এরা Gram‑positive stain হয় — gram‑positive oval budding yeast cell ও pseudohyphae হিসেবে দেখা যায়।

অন্য fungus — dermatophytes, Aspergillus, Mucor, Cryptococcus ইত্যাদি — Gram stain নির্ভরযোগ্যভাবে গ্রহণ করে না। তাই Gram stain‑এ gram‑positive yeast with pseudohyphae দেখলে candidiasis suggestive। অন্য fungus‑এর জন্য specialized stain — calcofluor white, LPCB, বা Indian ink (Cryptococcus‑এর জন্য negative stain)।

M20

Mention some important properties of Candida. ***

▾
📌 Hint: White fungus, yeast-like, normal flora, gram-positive, germ tube positive
▾ ✅ Answer

Important properties of Candida albicans:

  1. Also known as "white fungus" (due to white patches in oral thrush).
  2. Yeast-like fungus — oval yeast with a single bud. In tissues, appears as yeasts or pseudohyphae. True hyphae also form when invading tissues.
  3. Only fungus found as normal flora in the human body (GIT, upper respiratory tract, female genital tract).
  4. Only fungus that takes Gram stain — shows Gram positivity.
  5. Germ tube positive — forms germ tubes in serum at 37°C (specific for C. albicans).
  6. Can be isolated on blood agar media.
  7. Most common opportunistic fungus.
  8. Morphology: budding yeast with pseudohyphae in tissue; chlamydospores and pseudohyphae in culture at 20–25°C.
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

কোন কোন Candida species আছে?

C. albicans, C. tropicalis, C. parapsilosis, C. glabrata, C. krusei, C. dubliniensis।

C. albicans‑কে অন্য Candida থেকে কীভাবে আলাদা করা হয়?

Germ tube test ও carbohydrate fermentation test দিয়ে আলাদা করা হয়।

Transmission কীভাবে?

Normal flora থেকে, আর vertical transmission — birth‑এর সময় colonized birth canal দিয়ে।

SDA ও blood agar‑এ colony কেমন?

Smooth, white, creamy colony।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, Candida albicans‑এর important properties বলছি।

  1. "White fungus" নামে পরিচিত — oral thrush‑এর white patch‑এর কারণে।
  2. Yeast‑like fungus — oval yeast, single bud; tissue‑এ yeast বা pseudohyphae হিসেবে দেখা যায়।
  3. একমাত্র fungus যা normal flora (GIT, upper respiratory tract, female genital tract)।
  4. একমাত্র fungus যা Gram stain নেয় — Gram‑positive দেখায়।
  5. Germ tube positive — serum‑এ 37°C‑এ germ tube তৈরি করে (C. albicans‑এর জন্য specific)।
  6. Blood agar‑এ isolate করা যায়।
  7. Most common opportunistic fungus।
  8. Morphology — tissue‑এ budding yeast with pseudohyphae; culture 20–25°C‑এ chlamydospore ও pseudohyphae।

Species — albicans, tropicalis, parapsilosis, glabrata, krusei, dubliniensis। C. albicans germ tube test ও carbohydrate fermentation test দিয়ে আলাদা করা হয়। Transmission — normal flora + vertical (birth canal)। Colony smooth, white, creamy।

M21

List the lesions produced by C. albicans. *****

▾
📌 Hint: Mucosal, cutaneous, chronic mucocutaneous, systemic
▾ ✅ Answer

C. albicans causes candidiasis (white fungus) with the following lesions:

A. Mucosal & Cutaneous Candidiasis:

  • Oral thrush — white patches (pseudomembrane) on tongue, mouth, or throat.
  • Vulvovaginal candidiasis (moniliasis) — vaginal discharge, itching.
  • Esophageal candidiasis
  • Onychomycosis — nail infection.
  • Diaper rash — in infants' diaper area.

B. Chronic Mucocutaneous Candidiasis:

  • Rare condition in early childhood associated with reduced cell-mediated immunity (CMI).

C. Systemic Candidiasis:

  • Candidemia (Candida in blood)
  • Meningitis
  • Endocarditis
  • Endophthalmitis
  • Subcutaneous nodules
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Oral thrush‑এর characteristic finding কী?

White pseudomembrane patch — যা scrape করে তুলে ফেলা যায়।

Vulvovaginal candidiasis‑এর আরেক নাম?

Moniliasis।

Systemic candidiasis কার জন্য life‑threatening?

Immunocompromised (ICU, post‑surgery, catheterized) রোগীদের জন্য life‑threatening।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, C. albicans candidiasis (white fungus)‑এর কিছু lesion তৈরি করে।

A. Mucosal & Cutaneous: Oral thrush (tongue/mouth/throat‑এ white pseudomembrane), Vulvovaginal candidiasis (moniliasis) (vaginal discharge, itching), Esophageal candidiasis, Onychomycosis (nail), Diaper rash (infant‑এর diaper area)।

B. Chronic Mucocutaneous Candidiasis: early childhood‑এর দুর্লভ অবস্থা, reduced CMI (cell‑mediated immunity)‑র সাথে যুক্ত।

C. Systemic Candidiasis: Candidemia (blood‑এ Candida), meningitis, endocarditis, endophthalmitis, subcutaneous nodule।

High‑yield note — oral thrush‑এর white pseudomembrane patch scrape করে ওঠে; vulvovaginal candidiasis‑কে moniliasis বলে; systemic candidiasis ICU/post‑surgery/catheterized immunocompromised রোগীর জন্য life‑threatening।

M22

State the predisposing factors for candidiasis. ****

▾
📌 Hint: Physiological, immunodeficiency, drugs, trauma, endocrine, others
▾ ✅ Answer

Predisposing factors for candidiasis:

  1. Physiological: Infancy, pregnancy, old age.
  2. Immunodeficiency diseases: AIDS, malignancy (leukemia, lymphoma), chronic granulomatous disease, aplastic anemia.
  3. Drugs (Iatrogenic): Antibiotics (disrupt normal flora), steroids, oral contraceptive pills, anti-cancer drugs.
  4. Traumatic: Burns, infection.
  5. Endocrine: Diabetes mellitus.
  6. Others: Catheterization, IV drug abuse, conditions causing neutropenia.
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Antibiotic কীভাবে candidiasis predispose করে?

Antibiotic প্রতিযোগী bacterial flora নষ্ট করে, তাই Candida overgrowth হয়।

Steroid/immunosuppressant কীভাবে?

এরা CMI কমায়, যা Candida নিয়ন্ত্রণের key।

Diabetes mellitus কীভাবে predispose করে?

Diabetes‑এ high‑glucose environment থাকে, যা fungal growth‑এর জন্য favorable।

Catheter/IV line‑এর ভূমিকা?

Catheter আর IV line Candida‑র জন্য bloodstream‑এ সরাসরি প্রবেশপথ তৈরি করে।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, candidiasis‑এর predisposing factors বলছি।

  1. Physiological: infancy, pregnancy, old age।
  2. Immunodeficiency: AIDS, malignancy (leukemia, lymphoma), chronic granulomatous disease, aplastic anemia।
  3. Drugs (Iatrogenic): antibiotic (normal flora disrupt করে), steroid, oral contraceptive pill, anti‑cancer drug।
  4. Traumatic: burn, infection।
  5. Endocrine: diabetes mellitus।
  6. Others: catheterization, IV drug abuse, neutropenia।

Mechanism ধরলে extra point — antibiotic প্রতিযোগী bacterial flora নষ্ট করে, তাই Candida overgrow করে; steroid/immunosuppressant CMI কমায়; diabetes high‑glucose environment দেয়; catheter/IV line bloodstream‑এ সরাসরি প্রবেশপথ দেয়।

M23

Write down the laboratory diagnosis of candidiasis. *****

▾
📌 Hint: Specimen, microscopy (wet mount, Gram stain), culture (SDA, blood agar), germ tube test
▾ ✅ Answer

Laboratory Diagnosis of Candidiasis:

1. Specimen Collection: Swabs from site of infection — oral swab, throat swab, vaginal swab.

2. Microscopical Examination:

  • Wet mount preparation: Finding — budding yeast with pseudohyphae.
  • Gram stain: Gram-positive budding yeast cells.

3. Culture / Isolation and Identification:

  • Smooth, white, creamy colonies.
  • Media: SDA (Sabouraud's Dextrose Agar) and Blood Agar (containing antibiotic).

4. Immunological Tests: Usually not done.

5. Molecular Detection: PCR.

6. Other Tests:

  • Germ tube test: To differentiate C. albicans from other Candida species.
  • Carbohydrate fermentation test: To differentiate various Candida species.
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

C. albicans germ tube তৈরি করে, অন্য Candida কেন না?

C. albicans serum‑এ 37°C‑এ germ tube তৈরি করে; most other pathogenic Candida করে না — এটাই পার্থক্যের ভিত্তি।

Germ tube test‑এর procedure কী?

Colony থেকে sample → 0.5 ml human/sheep serum‑এ mix → 37°C‑এ 2 hours incubate → wet mount → tube‑like projection (germ tube) দেখা যায়।

SDA ছাড়া অন্য কোন media‑তে Candida isolate হয়?

Blood agar‑এও isolate করা যায়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, candidiasis‑এর lab diagnosis বলছি।

১. Specimen: infection site থেকে swab — oral, throat, vaginal।

২. Microscopy: wet mount‑এ budding yeast with pseudohyphae; Gram stain‑এ gram‑positive budding yeast।

৩. Culture: smooth, white, creamy colony; media SDA ও Blood Agar (antibiotic সহ)।

৪. Immunological: সাধারণত করা হয় না। ৫. Molecular: PCR।

৬. Other tests: germ tube test — C. albicans‑কে অন্য species থেকে আলাদা করে; carbohydrate fermentation — species differentiate করে।

Extra detail — germ tube test: colony + 0.5 ml serum → 37°C 2 hr → wet mount → tube‑like projection; শুধু C. albicans করে, অন্যরা করে না। Blood agar‑এও isolate করা যায়।

M24

S/N: Germ tube test. ** (used to differentiate Candida albicans to other candida spp)

▾
📌 Hint: Used to differentiate Candida albicans from other Candida species
▾ ✅ Answer

Germ Tube Test is a specific test for Candida albicans. It distinguishes C. albicans (which produces germ tubes) from other Candida species (which do not).

Procedure:

  1. Take a small amount of specimen from a colony of culture.
  2. Mix with 0.5 ml of human or sheep serum.
  3. Incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.
  4. Examine under microscope after wet mount preparation.

Result: Tube-like projections or outgrowths of yeasts (germ tubes) are found → positive → confirms C. albicans.

Significance: This is a rapid, simple, and inexpensive test widely used in clinical microbiology labs. C. albicans is the only Candida species that reliably produces germ tubes in serum.

▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Pseudohyphae আর germ tube কি আলাদা জিনিস?

হ্যাঁ — pseudohyphae হলো budding‑এর পর attached থাকা elongated cell‑এর chain (germ tube থেকে আলাদা); germ tube হলো true tube‑like projection।

Chlamydospore কী, আর C. albicans‑এ কখন হয়?

Chlamydospore হলো rounded, thick‑walled, resistant spore — C. albicans‑এ culture 20–25°C‑এ তৈরি হয়।

Candida species differentiate করার অন্য পদ্ধতি?

Carbohydrate fermentation test।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, germ tube test হলো Candida albicans‑এর জন্য specific test — এটা C. albicans (যে germ tube produce করে)‑কে অন্য Candida species (যারা produce করে না) থেকে আলাদা করে।

Procedure — (১) culture colony থেকে সামান্য specimen; (২) 0.5 ml human বা sheep serum‑এ mix; (৩) 37°C‑এ 2 ঘণ্টা incubate; (৪) wet mount preparation করার পর microscope‑এ examine। Result — germ tube (tube‑like projection) দেখা গেলে → positive → C. albicans confirm।

Significance — rapid, simple, inexpensive test, clinical lab‑এ বহুল ব্যবহৃত। C. albicans‑ই একমাত্র Candida যা serum‑এ নির্ভরযোগ্যভাবে germ tube produce করে।

Clarification — pseudohyphae (Candida‑তেও হয়, elongated cell‑এর chain) germ tube নয়; chlamydospore C. albicans culture 20–25°C‑এ rounded thick‑walled resistant spore; carbohydrate fermentation অন্য differentiate পদ্ধতি।

M25

Mention the important properties, diseases & laboratory diagnosis of C. neoformans. **** (properties: only capsulated fungus, morphology yeast, causes meningitis)

▾
📌 Hint: Only capsulated fungus, morphology yeast, causes meningitis
▾ ✅ Answer

Properties of Cryptococcus neoformans:

  • Only capsulated fungus — unique among all pathogenic fungi.
  • Morphology: Yeast — round or oval budding yeast with a narrow-based bud.
  • Opportunistic fungus.
  • Transmission: inhalation.
  • Source: Bird (especially pigeon) droppings.

Diseases:

  • Cryptococcal meningitis — especially in AIDS / immunocompromised patients.
  • Cryptococcal pneumonia.
  • Cryptococcosis (general term).

Laboratory Diagnosis:

  1. Specimen: CSF, sputum.
  2. Indian ink preparation (negative stain): round/oval yeast with narrow-based bud surrounded by a wide unstained capsule (clear halo against dark background).
  3. Culture on SDA at 37°C for 2–3 days: cream-colored mucoid colonies.
  4. CRAG test (Cryptococcal antigen): capsular antigen detection by latex agglutination test.
  5. PCR — molecular detection.
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

C. neoformans আর B. dermatitidis‑এর bud‑এর পার্থক্য কী?

C. neoformans‑এর yeast‑এ narrow‑based bud; B. dermatitidis‑এ broad‑based bud — এটাই key differentiator।

Capsule‑এর কাজ কী (virulence)?

Capsule polysaccharide দিয়ে তৈরি, এটাই main virulence factor — এটি phagocytosis inhibit করে।

কোন কোন fungus meningitis করতে পারে?

C. neoformans, Coccidioides immitis, Paracoccidioides brasiliensis, Blastomyces dermatitidis, Aspergillus fumigatus।

CRAG test‑এর উপযোগিতা?

Highly sensitive ও specific — diagnosis ও treatment response monitoring দুটোতেই ব্যবহৃত হয়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, Cryptococcus neoformans‑এর properties, disease ও lab diagnosis বলছি।

Properties: একমাত্র capsulated fungus — সব pathogenic fungus‑এর মধ্যে unique। Morphology yeast — round/oval budding yeast, narrow‑based bud। Opportunistic fungus। Transmission inhalation, source bird (বিশেষ করে pigeon) droppings।

Diseases: Cryptococcal meningitis — বিশেষ করে AIDS/immunocompromised; cryptococcal pneumonia; cryptococcosis (সাধারণ নাম)।

Lab diagnosis: (১) specimen — CSF, sputum; (২) Indian ink preparation (negative stain) — round/oval yeast + narrow‑based bud + wide unstained capsule (clear halo); (৩) SDA‑তে 37°C‑এ 2–3 দিন — cream‑colored mucoid colony; (৪) CRAG test — capsular antigen, latex agglutination দিয়ে detect; (৫) PCR।

Extra point — capsule polysaccharide‑নির্মিত, main virulence factor, phagocytosis inhibit করে; C. neoformans narrow‑based, B. dermatitidis broad‑based; CRAG diagnosis + monitoring‑এ ব্যবহৃত।

M26

Write down the peculiar properties of Pneumocystis jiroveci/ Explain- "what type of organism is Pneumocystis jiroveci"? *** (at morphology: like parasites and at molecular level: like fungus)

▾
📌 Hint: At morphology: like parasites; at molecular level: like fungus
▾ ✅ Answer

Pneumocystis jiroveci is a unique organism that has features of both fungi and parasites. It is now classified as a fungus based on molecular evidence.

Peculiar Properties:

  • Human species: Pneumocystis jiroveci; Rat species: Pneumocystis carinii.
  • Transmission: Inhalation of airborne organism.
  • Disease: Atypical pneumonia (plasma cell pneumonia) — ground glass opacity on imaging.
  • Mortality: Approximately 100% if untreated.

Why it looks like a parasite:

  • Cell membrane contains cholesterol (not ergosterol — unlike typical fungi).
  • In tissue, appears as cysts (resembles protozoal cysts).
  • Does not grow on standard fungal culture media.
  • Antifungal drugs are largely ineffective.
  • Major surface glycoprotein shows antigenic variation similar to Trypanosoma brucei.

Why it is classified as a fungus:

  • Molecular analysis: rRNA sequencing, mitochondrial DNA analysis, and major enzyme studies support fungal classification (related to yeasts like Saccharomyces cerevisiae).
  • Cell wall contains β-glucans.

Laboratory Diagnosis:

  • Specimen: lung biopsy, bronchoalveolar lavage (sputum not suitable).
  • Staining: methenamine silver, Giemsa, or fluorescent antibody stain → typical cysts.
  • Culture: difficult.
  • ELISA for antigen & antibody — only for epidemiological purpose.
  • PCR.
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

P. jiroveci কি আগে protozoan ছিল?

হ্যাঁ — আগে protozoan হিসেবে শ্রেণিবদ্ধ ছিল; molecular study‑র পর fungi‑তে রূপান্তরিত হয়।

Ergosterol‑এর অনুপস্থিতি ও culture‑তে না ওঠা কীভাবে antifungal inefficacy ব্যাখ্যা করে?

Ergosterol না থাকা আর fungal media‑তে grow না করা — এই দুটোই conventional antifungal (যেগুলো ergosterol target করে)‑এর অকার্যকারিতা explains।

Treatment কী?

Trimethoprim‑sulfamethoxazole (TMP‑SMX) — এটা antibacterial/antiprotozoal, antifungal নয়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, Pneumocystis jiroveci একটি unique organism — fungus ও parasite দুটোরই বৈশিষ্ট্য আছে, আর molecular evidence‑র ভিত্তিতে এখন fungus হিসেবে শ্রেণিবদ্ধ।

Peculiar properties — Human species: P. jiroveci, rat species: P. carinii; transmission — airborne organism inhalation; disease — atypical pneumonia (plasma cell pneumonia), imaging‑এ ground glass opacity; untreated হলে mortality প্রায় 100%।

কেন parasite‑এর মতো দেখায় — (১) cell membrane‑এ cholesterol (ergosterol নয়); (২) tissue‑এ cyst হিসেবে দেখা যায়; (৩) standard fungal culture media‑তে grow করে না; (৪) antifungal drugs largely ineffective; (৫) major surface glycoprotein‑এ antigenic variation — Trypanosoma brucei‑এর মতো।

কেন fungus — molecular analysis (rRNA sequencing, mitochondrial DNA, enzyme study) Saccharomyces cerevisiae‑এর মতো yeast‑এর সাথে সম্পর্কিত; আর cell wall‑এ β‑glucan থাকে।

Lab diagnosis — specimen lung biopsy/BAL (sputum suitable নয়); staining — methenamine silver, Giemsa, fluorescent antibody → typical cyst; culture difficult; ELISA only epidemiological purpose; PCR। Treatment — TMP‑SMX (antibacterial/antiprotozoal, antifungal নয়)।

M27

What are the diseases produced by Aspergillus? *** (A. flavus: ocular infection, liver damage; A. fumigatus: Allergic aspergilosis, fungal ball or aspergilloma)

▾
📌 Hint: A. flavus: ocular infection, liver damage; A. fumigatus: Allergic aspergillosis, fungal ball
▾ ✅ Answer

Aspergillus species are molds with septate hyphae that form V-shaped (dichotomous) branches. Conidia form radiating chains.

Diseases by species:

Aspergillus flavus:

  • Ocular infections.
  • Liver damage or liver carcinoma — through its production of aflatoxins.

Aspergillus fumigatus:

  • Allergic aspergillosis:
    • Asthma (Type I hypersensitivity).
    • Allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis / farmer's lung (Type III hypersensitivity).
  • Fungal ball / Aspergilloma in the lungs — a radiopaque structure on chest X-ray that changes position when the patient moves from erect to supine.
  • Invasive aspergillosis — affecting lungs, liver, kidney, brain, eye etc.

Transmission: Airborne conidia.

Laboratory Diagnosis:

  • Microscopy: septate hyphae, regular V-shaped branches.
  • Culture: mold with green conidia in radiating chain.

Spoiled grain/peanut → liver metabolize → epoxide → p53 tumour suppressor gene‑এ mutation → hepatocellular carcinoma।

Aspergillus allergy কেন এত prominent (mechanism)?

Spore highly allergenic → immediate hypersensitivity → asthma, bronchopulmonary aspergillosis, eosinophilia, "wheal and flare" skin test reaction।

Aspergilloma chest X‑ray‑এ কেমন দেখা যায়?

Radiopaque ball — patient‑এর posture বদলালে position বদলায়।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, Aspergillus species হলো mold — septate hyphae, V‑shaped (dichotomous) branch; conidia radiating chain‑এ থাকে। diseases species অনুযায়ী আলাদা।

A. flavus — ocular infection; liver damage বা liver carcinoma — কারণ এটা aflatoxin produce করে। A. fumigatus — allergic aspergillosis (asthma — Type I hypersensitivity; allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis / farmer's lung — Type III hypersensitivity); fungal ball/aspergilloma — chest X‑ray‑এ radiopaque structure, posture বদলালে position বদলায় (erect→supine); invasive aspergillosis — lungs, liver, kidney, brain, eye।

Transmission — airborne conidia। Lab diagnosis — microscopy: septate hyphae, regular V‑shaped branch; culture: mold, green conidia radiating chain।

Aflatoxin pathway মনে রাখুন — spoiled grain/peanut → epoxide → p53 mutation → HCC; আর aspergilloma posture‑dependent radiopaque ball।

M28

Enumerate the black fungus and white fungus. Why they are so called? *** (Black fungus: Mucormycosis, here tissue necrosis make black area; white fungus: Candidiasis, here white patches).

▾
📌 Hint: Black fungus: Mucormycosis, tissue necrosis makes black area; white fungus: Candidiasis, white patches
▾ ✅ Answer

Black Fungus:

  • Disease: Mucormycosis (zygomycosis, phycomycosis).
  • Causative agents: Mucor & Rhizopus.
  • Why called "black": The infection causes tissue necrosis, which appears black in color.
  • Diseases: Rhinocerebral lesion (orbit, palate, face, nose & brain — cavernous sinus thrombosis is a common complication), pulmonary lesions (infarction, necrosis with cavitation).
  • Predisposing factors: Diabetes mellitus, immunocompromised state.
  • Microscopy: Non-septate (coenocytic) hyphae, irregular, right-angle branches.

White Fungus:

  • Disease: Candidiasis (especially invasive candidiasis).
  • Causative agents: Candida albicans (sometimes C. tropicalis, C. auris).
  • Why called "white": In candidiasis (like oral thrush), white patches are seen on the tongue, mouth, or throat.
▾ ❓ Cross questions (from additional)

Mucormycosis‑এর transmission ও culture note?

Transmission — asexual spore inhalation; culture‑তে spore sporangium‑এর ভিতরে enclosed থাকে।

Mucormycosis কেন prominent হলো (COVID era)?

COVID‑19 pandemic‑এ immunocompromised/diabetic রোগীদের মধ্যে এটি বেশি prominence পায়।

White fungus‑এর white color‑এর কারণ কী?

Pseudomembrane formation‑এর কারণে — যা pseudohyphae ও yeast cell দিয়ে তৈরি।

▾ 🗣️ ভাইভায় যেভাবে বুঝাব (বাংলা লিপি)

স্যার, black fungus আর white fungus দুটোই বলছি।

Black fungus — disease mucormycosis (zygomycosis, phycomycosis); causative agent Mucor & Rhizopus; "black" বলার কারণ tissue necrosis — যা কালো দেখায়। Diseases — rhinocerebral lesion (orbit, palate, face, nose & brain — cavernous sinus thrombosis common complication), pulmonary lesion (infarction, necrosis with cavitation)। Predisposing — diabetes mellitus, immunocompromised state। Microscopy — non‑septate (coenocytic) hyphae, irregular, right‑angle branch।

White fungus — disease candidiasis (বিশেষ করে invasive); causative agent Candida albicans (কখনো C. tropicalis, C. auris); "white" বলার কারণ oral thrush‑এর মতো candidiasis‑এ tongue, mouth, throat‑এ white patch দেখা যায়।
